Groww Trading App is sending misleading and false notifications. Whenever the market goes up, I receive a notification for PE (Put Option), and whenever the market goes down, I receive a notification for CE (Call Option). These misleading notifications have caused me losses amounting to lakhs of rupees. This is a very serious issue and reflects extremely poor service. I request Groww to investigate this matter immediately and take responsibility for the losses caused by these notifications.

The app makes investing simple, but redeeming your money is a huge problem. I requested a withdrawal 3 weeks ago, and while the app status says "Transaction Successful," the funds were never credited to my bank account. I have raised multiple complaints and submitted my bank statement and cancelled cheque 5–6 times, but customer support just loops the same automated response that they are "working on it." Extremely poor customer service and handling of users' money.
